title: Analyze chat history in RAG Pattern App with Azure Cosmos DB and Microsoft Fabric
description: This project is a demo from Fabric Conference Europe 2024 and demonstrates how to do a deep analysis of chat history in a RAG Pattern application using Azure Cosmos DB and Microsoft Fabric. The project includes a sample dataset of chat history from a RAG Pattern application for a retail store application. The chat history is stored in AzureCosmos DB and is replicated to Microsoft Fabric One Lake using Fabric Mirroring. Microsoft Fabric is used for analyzing the chat data to provide insights and recommendations.
author: Hossein Heris
